description:
From the fz-kdt.192 cold review (2026-09-03, probes X2/X2B), PRE-EXISTING at
8de517a28 and unchanged by 192: match_arrow(((a)->b)::b, [(int)->int |
(v999)->v999]) answers Known (int)->int / int although has_vars(arg) is true.
collect_arrow_match descends per union clause; the var-carrying member
contributes nothing, the ground members ground everything, and the verdict
claims a runtime FACT from an observation still carrying in-flight variables.
192 makes it reachable on three more corpus rows (Range.reduce_while_cont's
6th argument, a union of three arrows with a free a5_p1: base Invalid by a
false negative, 192 Known). The principle the calculator already applies to
the solvability GATE (fz-kdt.184's fix 3: a var-carrying argument cannot arm
a check) and to OPENNESS (fz-kdt.120: a position whose argument is not ground
contributes nothing) says the verdict must be capped at Underconstrained
whenever any member of the observation at a bound position is not ground.
Do not fold into 192 (a second, unmeasured behaviour change). Measure the
corpus verdict census before/after (base K 21,039 / U 2,951 / I 13,946) and
whether any published return sharpens or widens. CONCORDANT: fz-kdt.184
(the gate half), fz-kdt.120 (the openness half), fz-kdt.190 (the contract
result consumed as a fact).

comments.text: fz-kdt.192 landed (343f3a134): pinned as x2_var_carrying_union_member_is_ignored_and_the_verdict_is_known and x2b_...wider_domain in arrow_match.rs -- a union-of-arrows argument with a free-variable member answers Known, a runtime fact claimed from an observation that is not ground. Unchanged by 192, and 192 makes it the ONLY remaining way groundness is manufactured; three corpus rows (Range.reduce_while_cont's 6th argument) moved Invalid -> Known through this door.

fz-kdt.184 landed (ca23b676f): the polarity split flips the pure-contravariant-variable case (a union-of-arrows argument whose free-variable member sits only under an arrow parameter) from Known to Underconstrained -- the "gate half" this ticket was credited with. x2 and x2b pin it. Your own corpus rows (Range.reduce_while_cont's 6th argument) are UNCHANGED (0 canon movers), because their variable also occurs covariantly and so still gets a lower bound; those rows stay Known from a non-ground observation, which is the half this ticket does not fix. Re-measure the remaining population on the 184 base before working it.

title: A @spec instantiation answers Known from a NON-GROUND observation: a union-of-arrows argument carrying a free variable grounds the result through its ground members while the var-carrying member contributes nothing
